title: Objections that prayer changes nothing
english: Next, as you asked, we must set out the persuasive claims of those who think [[prayer accomplishes nothing >> Bible:James 5:16]] because providence has already fixed all things. They ask: if God foreknows what will be, and what will be is fixed, why pray at all? We will overturn that.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 3 De oratione (OCR); no O’Meara/Greer/Chadwick wording.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: How providence and prayer move things together
english: Among things that move, some are moved from outside — lifeless things held only by habit — and others by nature or soul. Prayer is not among the useless motions: God works with those who ask according to the worth of the asking, so that [[ask and it will be given you >> Bible:Matthew 7:7]] stands with providence, not against it.
